contract.modeling_paradigm: Simulink dynamic model with a causal device-patient loop

public_inputs.name: obstruction_time
public_inputs.meaning: start time of a one-second temporary obstruction

outputs.name: airway
outputs.physical_source: measured at the ventilator-patient airway interface

outputs.name: lung_state
outputs.physical_source: computed from patient volume and compliance, not from the command

outputs.name: circuit_flow
outputs.physical_source: actual downstream circuit-flow balance at the patient/leak junction

outputs.name: actuator
outputs.physical_source: actual bounded actuator commands and safety-alarm state

contract.prompt:
Build a pressure-controlled mechanical-ventilation model coupled to a causal single-compartment patient lung. The ventilator must supply the patient through an airway with finite resistance and compliance, include inspiratory and expiratory flow actuation, and include a safety alarm that responds to over-pressure or persistent regulation error. No particular persistent-error threshold, alarm hold time, or controller structure is prescribed.

Read patient_compliance, airway_resistance, leak_fraction, target_insp_pressure, obstruction_factor, and obstruction_time from base-workspace variables. Their nominal values are 0.025 L/cmH2O, 12 cmH2O*s/L, 0.08, 22 cmH2O, 1.6, and 6 s. They operate respectively over 0.015--0.040 L/cmH2O, 8--20 cmH2O*s/L, 0--0.25, 18--28 cmH2O, 1--2.5, and 4--8 s. The obstruction factor applies for one second beginning at obstruction_time.

Assume a clean MATLAB session in which only the declared public inputs are provided. Use a 20 breaths/min pressure-controlled cycle with a 1:2 inspiratory-to-expiratory ratio and 5 cmH2O PEEP. Across the declared patient and leak range, airway pressure must be closed-loop regulated to the inspiratory target and PEEP, maintain physiologically directed patient flow and volume, respect a 35 cmH2O safety ceiling, and recover after the temporary obstruction.

Log Timeseries airway, lung_state, circuit_flow, and actuator. airway must contain [airway pressure in cmH2O, patient-directed flow in L/s, lung volume above PEEP in L]. lung_state must contain the alveolar pressure in cmH2O computed from the patient volume and compliance. circuit_flow must contain [ventilator delivered flow in L/s, circuit leak flow in L/s] measured at the downstream circuit junction, so that delivered flow supplies the patient branch and leak branch. actuator must contain [inspiratory-valve command, expiratory-valve command, alarm state]. These signals must come from the causal device-patient simulation rather than from duplicated commands or precomputed answer waveforms.

Work directly in the required model file and keep the latest usable state saved at that path throughout the task.

groups.G: simulation, output contract and finite causal device-patient signals
groups.Q: tidal-volume usefulness, ripple and pressure safety
groups.M: patient/circuit mass balance, leak-path response, phase-independent breath timing, positive multiscale valve-to-pressure/flow causality, passive linear-or-Rohrer airway resistance and strategy-neutral protection
groups.D: true in-run recovery after temporary obstruction

reference_sources.use: standard single-compartment elastic-pressure plus resistive-pressure relation; no source code copied

reference_sources.use: mechanism and scale audit only: pneumatic plant, lung resistance/compliance, breath sequencing, pressure/flow control and alarms
